    AI Overview
    ESPN Unlimited
     is a premium streaming service costing $29.99/month, offering comprehensive access to all 12 ESPN linear networks (ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, etc.), ESPN+, SEC Network, ACCN, and ESPN3, along with 47,000+ live events annually. It includes exclusive content, such as specific MLB games and top-court tennis matches. 
    Key Details About ESPN Unlimited 
    • Cost: $29.99 per month or $299.99 per year.
    • What's Included: Access to all ESPN cable networks and exclusive digital content. It does not include local ABC stations.
    • Content: Features live sports including NFL (Monday Night Football), NBA, NHL, MLB, college sports (SEC/ACC), and original content/studios shows like
      SportsCenter and First Take.
    • Bundles: Available as a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, often with a 12-month introductory offer.
    • How to Access: Through the ESPN app, a web browser, or via the Disney+ app.
    • Offers: A one-month free trial is sometimes offered with subscriptions like MLB.TV. 
    ESPN Unlimited vs. ESPN Select 
    • ESPN Unlimited ($29.99/mo): Includes all linear networks + ESPN+.
    • ESPN Select ($11.99/mo): Rebranded ESPN+; includes about 32,000 live events but not the main linear ESPN channels. 
    This service is designed as a direct-to-consumer option for cord-cutters to get the full, traditional cable ESPN experience without a cable subscription.

    What does ESPN Unlimited include?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    ESPN Unlimited is a premium, direct-to-consumer streaming plan providing comprehensive, cable-free access to the entire ESPN ecosystem for approximately $29.99/month [1, TVGuide.com]. It includes live feeds for all ESPN networks (ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPNDeportes, SEC Network, ACCN), along with thousands of live games from ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, and exclusive MLB.TV coverage. 
    Key Features & Content Included: 
    • Live TV Channels: Full access to ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACCN, and ESPN on ABC.
    • ESPN+ (now "Select") Content: Thousands of exclusive live events, including UFC, NHL, soccer (LaLiga, Bundesliga), and
      PGA Tour.
    • Major Sports Coverage: NFL (Monday Night Football), NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, tennis, and golf majors.
    • College Sports: Extensive coverage of NCAA football and basketball, including ACC, SEC, and Big 12 conferences.
    • Studio Shows & Originals: SportsCenter, First Take, College GameDay, and the 30 for 30 library.
    • Exclusive Content: WWE Premium Live Events, and Formula 1. 
    Access Details: 
    • Cost: Approximately $29.99/month or $299.99/year.
    • Platform: Stream directly on the ESPN App, or via the Disney Plus and Hulu apps.
    • Bundle Options: Often available in a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu. 
    This service acts as a complete replacement for a cable subscription for sports fans, offering more content than the lower-tier Antenna Land "ESPN Select" plan.
